title: On Global Embedding of Assisted Fibre Inflation
summary: Fibre inflation is one of the most attractive models realized in the type IIB orientifold compactification. It is embedded in the framework of L(arge) V(olume) S(cenarios) using a class of compactifying Calabi-Yau (CY) threefolds having K3-fibration. The standard single-field fibre inflation is driven by a fibre modulus which needs to travel a trans-Planckian distance of the order of ${\cal O}(5-8)$M$_p$ in the effective moduli space.
